name: Simic Manipulator — "power less than or equal to the number of +1/+1 counters removed this way" is asked for as X
notes: "{T}, Remove one or more +1/+1 counters from this creature: Gain control of target creature with power less than or equal to the number of +1/+1 counters removed this way." The bound was left unread, and the picker's list followed no number (it left out a 2-power creature, offered a 1-power one). How many counters the cost removed is the player's choice, so it is asked for as X when the ability is fired (_fireTimeCardValueAsX, cards-helpers.js) and read as "with power X or less". With X = 2: Grizzly Bears, Llanowar Elves and the card itself, not Hill Giant.
